The Bank of Guyana's financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2019 carry a Report of the External Auditors issued by the Auditor General, referenced 'AG: 30/2020' and dated 7 April 2020; the Letter of Transmittal states the statements were certified by the external auditors appointed in accordance with Section 60 of the Bank of Guyana Act. detail: Forbes África Lusófona reports that the Banco de Moçambique's 2019 accounts closed with a qualification from its independent auditor, printed as 'o BDO' ('fecharam com uma reserva do seu auditor independente, o BDO'), with the auditor's opinion signed 31 December 2021. The Bank's own 2021 relatório e contas lists a 'RELATÓRIO DO AUDITOR INDEPENDENTE' on pages 4-7 but those pages carry no extractable text, so the firm is recorded from the news source; the Maputo city value is BDO's Mozambique office location and is not printed in this source.
source_title: Banco de Moçambique fecha contas de 2019 com reservas do auditor - Forbes África Lusófona
